propositions: Root disk fills to 92-96% and remains pressurized during main quiescence because autodeploy no-op path (line 228) skips prune_docker_caches(), leaving garbage unclaimed between deploys.

Pressure-triggered, throttled docker prune on the no-op early exit will reclaim disk when root usage reaches or exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%), subject to a minimum interval throttle (default 600s).

prune_docker_caches() function must be relocated from line ~245 to the helper block (~150) so it is defined before its first call site at line 228, while preserving existing call sites (backoff, deploy paths).

New root_disk_pct() and reclaim_under_pressure() helpers will compute root disk percentage, check throttle window via persisted timestamp file, emit AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker, and invoke prune, with failures logged but non-fatal.
Prune failures on the pressure path do not alter autodeploy exit code and are logged only, matching deploy-path behavior.
